# The Bet · FinWise

> Module 1 · Ignite a PLG Motion. The growth hypothesis and where you're betting, plus the growth-loop visualization.

## Growth hypothesis

FinWise's biggest growth problem is FinWise's biggest growth problem is that the users don't see the value of the product quick enough, because because onboading and analyzing their data is a confusing and lengthy process.

_Working notes: Poor onboarding never allows customers to fully understand value of features Evidence: 1. Financial management is difficult, and there must be a lot of features to sort through with a reverse trial providing all available features. Customers don't know what to do, especially because they're unique
2. Low conversion 2% to continued paid customers (we aim for 10-30%)
3. High churn of 60% after 1 year of use Against the data: Average of 2% conversion from trial > paid (98% didn't convert)_

_____

## The bet

the highest leverage experiment I'd run first is building a personalized onboarding experience to help set up what they need

**Not doing:** more focus on the acquisition despite a high loss on there too

_____

## Growth loop

**Loop type:** Content-Driven, Financial management likely won't have much collaboration. We're spending a lot of money on acquiring users for trials, and does not mention referrals. If content driven can be focused on, then user may see more value on the app sooner.
